message: Muse Wonder esta imaginando tres juegos

concepts.controls: Hold and release Space to stretch and launch. Press Down to duck. Press Enter to start or retry.
concepts.core_mechanic: Holding Space stretches the dog's front half forward while its back feet stay planted, then releasing snaps its whole body through the air. A longer stretch flies farther but takes longer to snap, so players must judge distance rather than simply tap to jump.
concepts.juice: The dog squashes before stretching, wiggles while fully extended, and snaps forward with speed lines and dust puffs. Perfect landings pop floating text, bones spin off in sparkles, hydrant grazes cause a tiny screen shake, and passing each bus stop triggers a cheerful sign wiggle and distance banner. A paper-like street, paw-print trail, and big hand-drawn sprites keep the run charming and readable.
concepts.lose: Crash into three hydrants or cats and the run ends with the text 'OH NO! TRIPPED UP!'
concepts.palette: Warm cream, dog brown, hydrant red, and bus-stop blue on a dark outline.
concepts.pitch: Your dog has spotted the bus home and is stretching, snapping, and sprinting down the street to catch it. Time each rubber-band leap over hydrants, snatch bones mid-flight, and reach the final bus stop before your three tumbles run out.

roles.role: The large hero whose body visibly stretches and snaps forward with every jump.
The main ground obstacle to clear; clipping one costs a tumble and bursts a spray of water.
Floating treats placed along ideal jump arcs; grabbing five in a row restores one tumble.
A tall sitting blocker that must be ducked under its swiping paw or cleared with a very short hop.
Raised fence sections that act as landing platforms and change the height of upcoming jumps.
Milestone signs every 150 meters and the giant finish sign at the end of the street.

concepts.title: Long Dog Dash
concepts.win: Reach the big BUS STOP sign at 600 meters before losing all three tumbles to see 'YOU CAUGHT THE BUS!'

concepts.controls: Press Space on the beat to jump. Press Up to catch high notes and Down to duck low notes. Press Enter to start or retry.
concepts.core_mechanic: Notes ride the beat toward the dog, but a Perfect hit does more than score: it makes the next hydrant spray a water arc that carries the dog over the following two beats automatically if the player keeps tapping Space in rhythm. Staying in the spray builds a combo multiplier, while one off-beat tap breaks the arc, so success becomes a flowing rhythm chain instead of isolated button presses.
concepts.juice: Perfect hits flash 'PERFECT!', splash musical droplets, and make the fence bounce like a piano lid. The cat taps its tail on the beat, bones burst into note sparkles, and the dog's ears flop with squash-and-stretch on every landing. At each 'NEXT STOP!' warning the screen gives a bus-rumble shake, the tempo ticks up, and the water arc trails rainbow-tinted spray at high combos.
concepts.lose: Miss ten beats total and the screen shows 'OFF BEAT! THE CAT TAKES THE SOLO!'
concepts.palette: Sky blue, fence-post brown, hydrant red, and sunny yellow accents.
concepts.pitch: The neighborhood cat is drumming on the fence, and your dog has turned the morning bus route into a rhythm parade. Jump hydrants, catch bones, and duck cat swipes exactly on the beat to ride a chain of musical water sprays to the final stop.

roles.role: The big rhythm runner who jumps, stretches up, and ducks in time with the music.
Beat obstacles whose caps pop and spray the carry-over water arc after Perfect jumps.
High notes that drift over the beat line and must be caught with Up.
The fence-top drummer setting the tempo, and the source of low paw swipes cued for Down.
The scrolling music staff behind the track, with its posts marking each beat.
Large cue cards that swing in before tempo changes and mark the final measure.

concepts.title: Bus Stop Beat Parade
concepts.win: Finish all 48 beats of the route and land the final jump at the BUS STOP sign to see 'ON TIME AND ON BEAT!'

concepts.controls: Use the Arrow Keys or WASD to step and push. Press Space to bark. Press Enter to restart a yard or start the game.
concepts.core_mechanic: Hydrants do not stop after one tile: push one and it slides until a fence or sign stops it, spraying a line of water that shoves every loose bone one extra tile in the same direction. One good shove can solve half the yard, but every move also wakes the cat, which takes one step toward the nearest bone, so each push has to feed the cat before it reaches and hoards the bone for good.
concepts.juice: The dog wiggles its tail before each push, hydrants screech and spray sparkling water along their slide, and bones clink with a little hop when water shoves them. The cat's eyes pop open with a '!' when it wakes, dust puffs mark every step, and delivering a bone triggers a happy heart burst and floating 'YUM!' text. Solving a yard makes the bus stop sign spin like a celebration flag.
concepts.lose: If the cat reaches a bone first, or a bone ends up walled into a corner, the yard ends with 'THE CAT GOT THE BONE! PRESS ENTER TO TRY AGAIN.'
concepts.palette: Grassy green, warm fence brown, hydrant red, and creamy bone white.
concepts.pitch: Breakfast is scattered across three fenced yards, and a very determined cat wants every bone first. Push sliding hydrants to blast bones across the grass, feed the cat on purpose, then waltz out at the bus stop sign.

roles.role: The grid-stepping pusher who moves bones and hydrants and can bark once per yard to freeze the cat for three moves.
Heavy sliding blocks whose water spray pushes bones one extra tile when they stop.
The pushable prize that must be delivered to the cat in each yard.
A sleepy rival who wakes after your first push and steps toward the nearest bone each turn until fed.
The yard walls and inner barriers that stop sliding hydrants and shape every solution.
Both a sturdy stopper for sliding hydrants and the exit tile the dog must reach after feeding the cat.

concepts.title: Bone Yard Shuffle
concepts.win: Feed the cat and reach the BUS STOP sign in all three yards to see 'ALL FED! TIME FOR THE PARK!'

message: 3 construcciones en paralelo; gana la primera que pase los chequeos

data.advice: Winnable, and no dumb policy wins.

minor: Floating 'BONE 2/5' pickup text briefly overlaps the dog sprite in mid-play capture, typical motion overlap.

message: #2 Long Dog Dash is a hand-drawn endless runner where your stretching dog sprints 600 meters past hydrants, cats, and fences to catch the bus home. Hold and release Space to stretch and snap through the air, press Down to duck under cats, collect five bones in a row to earn back a tumble, and press Enter to start or retry.
